name: 60-fence-aware-trim
prompt:
`go test ./...` fails in package md: Clean does not yet do its job. Make every test pass without modifying md_test.go, and keep gofmt happy.
Clean's contract: it returns a slice of the same length, it never changes leading whitespace, and it removes trailing spaces and tabs from each line — except inside fenced code blocks. A line whose whitespace-trimmed form starts with ``` opens a fenced block and the next such line closes it; the opening fence line, the closing fence line and every line between them are returned byte for byte as they came in. A block that is never closed runs to the end of the document. Run the tests after your change: this contract has more than one part and the first thing that makes the failing test pass will not satisfy the rest.
